Very transparent overdrive that keeps all the quality of your clear sound while finding the desired saturated harmonics. 3 steps for 3 types of clipping, jazz, blues or rock style. Inside, a potentiometer permits you to completely transform your overdrive from a very transparent sound to a warm distortion! The cerberus offers infinite types of overdrive in one unique pedal!   ethical manufacturing All Anasounds’ pedals are handmade in France with care in order to propose the best pedals we can provide. Go visit our handmade page to learn about our production processes   don’t be shy, have a try Find your local dealer to test and buy your Cerberus Or go to Anasounds shop and get 30 day free trials     THE CERBERUS IN DEPTH electronic Get Cerberus manual now! Years of research and prototypes examined how all overdrives are related. We decided to focus on two different sides : – Anasounds technology of voicing allows you to change the saturation density from a soft and creamy overdrive to a modern and keen one. – the second effort was with the compression and clipping, in order to define 3 interesting voicings giving different intensities of saturation regardless of the gain setting.   get your tone by the inside Get Cerberus manual now! sw_tone To adjust the frequency range of your tone potentiometer. asym Choose whether you want a fifth diode or not on the second position of the clipping selector. Then, you will get asymmetrical clipping. voicing/roll off The famous setting that changes all the sound of your drive. This is the frequency from which the circuit saturates. Below this frequency, the overdrive only adds volume.
